# Life-science sources

<!-- Generated by scripts/sources-doc.js from src/catalog — do not edit by hand. -->

47 sources, 206 entities, 663 relations.  Query any of them by name:

```graphql
{
  query(input: {
    source: "uniprot"
    from: "protein"
    where: { uniprotAccession: "P04637" }
    include: ["structures", "pathways", "target"]
  }) { count data }
}
```

`where` keys are the entity's parameters (required ones marked \*); `include` takes relation names, and
dots follow them further (`"structures.entry"`).  `raw: true` returns records exactly as the source sent them.

**OBO keys** (superscripts) say which identifier space a field or parameter holds, as registered in the
[Bioregistry](https://bioregistry.io).  Two fields with the same key and the same value name the same thing,
so relations are declared by key (`by uniprot`), and any entity whose required parameter takes a key a field
carries can be included without a declaration at all: `include: ["pdbe/bestStructures"]` (the *Linked by key*
column lists them).  Keyed values are written one canonical way whatever the source sent — see
[OBO keys](#obo-keys).

## Genes & genomes

### ensembl

**Ensembl** — Genome annotation for vertebrates and model organisms: genes, transcripts, variants with predicted consequences (VEP), orthologues (Compara) and cross-references. Species use Ensembl names such as homo_sapiens.

Base URL: `https://rest.ensembl.org` · [Home](https://www.ensembl.org) · [API docs](https://rest.ensembl.org/documentation) · Licence: No restrictions (Ensembl data is freely available) · Throttled to 12 req/s

### ncbi-gene

### hgnc

**HGNC** — HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee: approved symbols and names for human genes, with previous symbols, aliases and authoritative links to Ensembl, NCBI Gene, UniProt, OMIM, MGI and RGD.

Base URL: `https://rest.genenames.org` · [Home](https://www.genenames.org) · [API docs](https://www.genenames.org/help/rest/) · Licence: CC0 · Throttled to 8 req/s

### mygene

**MyGene.info** — Gene annotation aggregated from NCBI Gene, Ensembl, UniProt, HGNC and more, searchable by symbol, name, alias or annotation field across species. Fast way to resolve any gene identifier to the others.

Base URL: `https://mygene.info/v3` · [Home](https://mygene.info) · [API docs](https://docs.mygene.info/en/latest/) · Licence: Aggregated sources keep their own licences; the service is free to use · Throttled to 10 req/s

### genbank

**GenBank / RefSeq sequences** — Nucleotide and protein sequence records from GenBank, RefSeq, EMBL and DDBJ (INSDC) via NCBI E-utilities: accession, title, length, molecule type, organism and dates.

### ncbi

**NCBI E-utilities** — Generic access to every NCBI Entrez database (gene, protein, nuccore, pubmed, clinvar, gds, taxonomy, assembly, biosample, …): search with Entrez query syntax, then fetch document summaries and cross-database links.

Base URL: `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils` · [Home](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/) · [API docs](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK25497/) · Licence: Public domain (US Government work); some records carry their own terms · Throttled to 3 req/s · Optional API key via `apiKeys: { "ncbi": "…" }` ([get one](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account/settings/))

| Entity | Where | Fields | Include | Linked by key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **databases**<br>An Entrez database that can be searched<br><sub>e.g. `{}`</sub> |  | `db` |  |  |
| **search**<br>The UID of one record matching an Entrez query<br><sub>e.g. `{"db":"gene","term":"TP53[sym] AND human[orgn]"}`</sub> | `db`\*, `term`\*, `sort` | `db`, `id`, `hit` | `summary` → summaryOfSearchHit |  |
| **summary**<br>The Entrez document summary of one or more records (fields vary by database)<br><sub>e.g. `{"db":"gene","id":"7157"}`</sub> | `db`\*, `id`\* | `db`, `id`, `title`, `docsum` |  |  |
| **records**<br>Document summaries of the records matching an Entrez query (search and summary in one)<br><sub>e.g. `{"db":"protein","term":"TP53[gene] AND human[orgn] AND refseq[filter]"}`</sub> | `db`\*, `term`\*, `sort` | `db`, `id`, `title`, `docsum` |  |  |
| **summaryOfSearchHit**<br>The document summary of a "db:uid" hit as returned by search or links — lets a relation summarise without knowing the database in advance<br><sub>e.g. `{"hit":"gene:7157"}`</sub> | `hit`\* | `db`, `id`, `title`, `docsum` |  |  |
| **links**<br>A record in one Entrez database linked from a record in another (elink)<br><sub>e.g. `{"dbfrom":"gene","db":"protein","id":"7157","linkname":"gene_protein_refseq"}`</sub> | `dbfrom`\*, `db`\*, `id`\*, `linkname` | `dbfrom`, `id`, `db`, `linkname`, `linkedId`, `linkedHit` | `summary` → summaryOfSearchHit |  |

### ena

**ENA – European Nucleotide Archive** — EMBL-EBI archive of raw sequencing reads, assemblies and annotated nucleotide sequences, organised as studies, samples, experiments and runs (INSDC member, mirrors SRA/DDBJ).

### regulondb

### ols

**Ontology Lookup Service (OLS)** — EBI's Ontology Lookup Service: one API over 250+ biomedical ontologies — MONDO, EFO, HP, GO, UBERON, CL, ChEBI, DOID, NCBITaxon and more. Look up a term by CURIE, walk its hierarchy, or search across ontologies.

Base URL: `https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api` · [Home](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/) · [API docs](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/help) · Licence: Apache-2.0 (service); each ontology carries its own licence · Throttled to 10 req/s

### hpo

**Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO)** — Standardised vocabulary of phenotypic abnormalities in human disease, with phenotype–gene and phenotype–disease (OMIM, Orphanet) annotations. Term ids look like HP:0001250.

Base URL: `https://ontology.jax.org/api` · [Home](https://hpo.jax.org) · [API docs](https://ontology.jax.org/api/docs) · Licence: HPO licence (free with attribution) — https://hpo.jax.org/license · Throttled to 5 req/s

### mesh

**MeSH – Medical Subject Headings** — NLM controlled vocabulary used to index MEDLINE/PubMed: descriptors with tree numbers, scope notes and entry terms (synonyms), searchable by label and linked to the PubMed articles indexed with them.

## Chemistry & drugs

### chembl

**ChEMBL** — Manually curated database of bioactive drug-like molecules: 2.4M compounds, their protein targets, 20M+ measured activities, and the mechanisms and indications of approved and clinical drugs.

## Literature

### europepmc

**Europe PMC** — Life-science literature search over 45M+ abstracts (PubMed, preprints, patents, Agricola) and 10M+ full-text articles, with abstracts, MeSH terms, open-access status and the citation graph (who cites whom).

Base URL: `https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest` · [Home](https://europepmc.org) · [API docs](https://europepmc.org/RestfulWebService) · Licence: Metadata free to use; article text under each article's own licence · Throttled to 10 req/s

### gtex

**GTEx Portal** — Genotype-Tissue Expression: median gene expression (TPM) and single-tissue eQTLs across ~50 human tissues from ~1 000 donors. Queried by unversioned Ensembl gene id; the GENCODE version is resolved per release.

Base URL: `https://gtexportal.org/api/v2` · [Home](https://gtexportal.org) · [API docs](https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/redoc) · Licence: Open access (dbGaP-protected individual-level data is not exposed by this API) · Throttled to 5 req/s

### proteinatlas

**Human Protein Atlas** — Tissue, single-cell, blood and cancer expression of every human protein-coding gene, with antibody-based subcellular localisation, secretome classification and cancer prognostic associations.

Base URL: `https://www.proteinatlas.org` · [Home](https://www.proteinatlas.org) · [API docs](https://www.proteinatlas.org/about/help/dataaccess) · Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 · Throttled to 5 req/s

### geo

**GEO – Gene Expression Omnibus** — NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus: microarray and sequencing-based functional genomics series (GSE), curated datasets (GDS), platforms and samples, searchable with Entrez query syntax and linked to their publications.

Base URL: `https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils` · [Home](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/) · [API docs](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/info/geo_paccess.html) · Licence: Free to use; submitters may hold rights to some data (NCBI policy) · Throttled to 3 req/s · Optional API key via `apiKeys: { "geo": "…" }` ([get one](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account/settings/))

| Entity | Where | Fields | Include | Linked by key |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **datasets**<br>GEO records (series, datasets, platforms, samples) matching a query<br><sub>e.g. `{"term":"TP53 AND Homo sapiens[ORGN]","entryType":"gse"}`</sub> | `term`\*, `entryType` | `accession`<sup>geo</sup>, `title`, `summary`, `organism`, `type`, `entryType`, `platform`, `series`, `sampleCount`, `publicationDate`, `pmids`<sup>pubmed</sup>, `bioproject`, `supplementaryFiles`, `ftpLink` | `publications` → pubmed.article <sub>by pubmed</sub> | <details><summary>4</summary>`europepmc/article(pmids)` `europepmc/citations(pmids)` `europepmc/references(pmids)` `geo/dataset(accession)`</details> |

### biosamples

**BioSamples** — EMBL-EBI registry of the biological samples behind archived omics data: organism, tissue, cell type, disease and free-form attributes, often ontology-annotated. Includes every INSDC (ENA/SRA/DDBJ) sample.

Base URL: `https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biosamples` · [Home](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biosamples/) · [API docs](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biosamples/docs/references/api/overview) · Licence: Open; submitters' terms may apply to individual records · Throttled to 5 req/s

## OBO keys

Identifier spaces Mozg recognises, with the form values are written in.  `curie` values carry their prefix (`CHEBI:15365`); `local` values are bare (`P04637`).  A field named in the last column carries the key by convention; names ending in it do too (`partnerUniprotAccession`).

| Key | Prefix | Form | Field | What it identifies |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `uniprot` | `uniprot` | local | `uniprotAccession` | UniProtKB accession |
| `ensembl` | `ensembl` | local | `ensemblGeneId` | Ensembl stable id |
| `ncbigene` | `NCBIGene` | local | `ncbiGeneId` | NCBI Gene id |
| `hgnc` | `HGNC` | curie | `hgncId` | HGNC gene id |
| `hgnc.symbol` | `hgnc.symbol` | local |  | HGNC gene symbol |
| `ncbitaxon` | `NCBITaxon` | local | `taxonId` | NCBI Taxonomy id |
| `pdb` | `pdb` | local | `pdbId` | PDB entry |
